missing: The fence is a filesystem-namespace boundary, not a syscall sandbox: a candidate's declared test command runs with its cwd inside the fence but could still write absolute paths outside it. In the autonomous path (cloud_rsi::apply_plan) the command is susi-declared verify argv and only the model-authored file set is untrusted, which the fence fully confines; a malicious-command sandbox would be a separate feature. Fenced workspaces under root/patches are retained as evidence and never auto-cleaned.
